behavior: Query the original provider by original client key and conditionally reconcile its verified result.

sourceBinding.status: source-reconciled specification; no current runtime or compliance verdict

domainModelNotes: No Procurement domain-event object is emitted. GoodsReceived is a separate producer-owned integration contract on first receipt.
steps: Load purchase; missing order raises purchase_not_found.
Always call LookupAsync with immutable original identity, including for a settled order.
Found verified outcome: apply under lock, preserving matching settled state and rejecting contradictions.
NotFound/Unknown: mark unsettled state unknown; preserve settled state.
failureSemantics: supplier_invalid_response propagates for a settled order; for an unsettled order it is retained as unknown.
Other SupplierGatewayException preserves a settled order or marks an unsettled one unknown.
Caller cancellation propagates through gateway; lookup is not an automatic POST retry.
postconditions: Never switch provider/key or create a replacement purchase.
No receipt, outbox or inventory mutation.
discrepancies: PS-D01: old workflow text said accepted local order simply returns itself; actual implementation still looks up supplier.
